# Berkeley RDI

> Berkeley Center for Responsible, Decentralized Intelligence conducts cutting-edge research and education in agentic AI, cryptography, and decentralized systems with a focus on safety and responsible development.

Berkeley RDI is an interdisciplinary research center at UC Berkeley led by prominent computer scientists including Dawn Song and Shafi Goldwasser. The center combines theoretical cryptography, AI safety research, and practical education to advance responsible intelligence systems.

## Key Topics

- Agentic AI
- Decentralized Intelligence
- Zero Knowledge Proofs
- AI Safety
- Cryptography
- LLM Agents
- Responsible AI
- Cybersecurity
- Program Synthesis
- Decentralized Systems
- Berkeley Center for Responsible, Decentralized Intelligence
- Education MOOC
- AI Research

## Core Research & Mission

- [Berkeley RDI](https://rdi.berkeley.edu): Homepage for Berkeley Center for Responsible, Decentralized Intelligence
- [Research](https://rdi.berkeley.edu/research): Research initiatives in agentic AI, safety, and decentralized intelligence
- [People](https://rdi.berkeley.edu/people): Faculty and research team directory including Dawn Song and Christine Parlour

## Education & Learning

- [Education](https://rdi.berkeley.edu/education): MOOCs and courses on agentic AI, cryptography, and web3 technologies
- [Zero Knowledge Proofs](https://rdi.berkeley.edu/zk-learning): Zero Knowledge Proofs MOOC course with leading cryptography experts

## Community & Engagement

- [Events](https://rdi.berkeley.edu/events): Events, workshops, and seminars hosted by Berkeley RDI
- [Blog](https://rdi.berkeley.edu/blog): Research blog covering agentic AI, security, and decentralized systems
